text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп stares intensely at a magazine
in her hands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow... That sea urchin's glistening like
liquid gold over a plate of
pasta... It looks
more like treasure than it does food...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
And those warm pancakes look like they'd
go perfectly with that
vanilla ice cream...
Not to mention all the fresh fruit. Such an

exquisite dish...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was looking for a place to eat
on my next day off. There
are so many
options though. It took forever for me to
decide...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list: So you found a place you like?

text_block_list.text:
I did. Apparently, it's some small, hidden
cafe known for its pasta and
pancakes.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's just... The other day, I saw an ad for a
similarly hidden ramen shop
and thought I
could find my way there...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
But I got hopelessly lost, even though I
used a map and everything. I
could've
sworn I had gotten on the right train...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I guess they aren't called hidden for
nothing. It's no small feat finding
your way
there.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Wait... Could it be these shops are
disguising themselves and hiding
from
public eyes?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list:
Disguising themselves? They're not ninja
shops...

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Then why is it that I wasn't able
to reach my destination?
Truly a mystery.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Taking a look at the magazine's map, I
notice that it's a bit difficult to
navigate.
I'm not sure if Огури Кэп would be able to
find her way
there by herself...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How about I go with you?

text_block_list.text: Really?! You'd do that?!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, I'm sure we'll get
there without a problem. I'll
gladly take
you up on that offer, thank you.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Our next day off rolls around, and after a
short train ride, we find
ourselves standing
in front of the tucked-away cafe.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So this is where it is... You sure know your
way around town. Not even
a single wrong
turn.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's nothing... I just feel a bit out of place...
I mean, look around you!
It's so fancy.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Is it okay for me to be dressed like this? I
heard some restaurants in
the city kick you
out if you're dressed poorly...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I see... That's a relief to hear, but... I still
feel like I'm somehow
standing out...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Are you ready to order?
text_block_list.name: Waitress A

text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... Let's see... What was I gonna
order, again?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it. I forgot what they're called
though... Some
hard-to-remember names...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
They were both in French, I think... One of
them was a sea urchin
pasta...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list:
We'll have two plates of sea urchin pasta, thank
you.

text_block_list.text: Ah, the "lumière dorèe" pâtes à la crème.
text_block_list.name: Waitress A

text_block_list.text:
So you can order without knowing the
dish's actual name... I see.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but could we also get two servings
of those pancakes topped
with fresh fruit?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Two crêpes aux fruits. Very well.
text_block_list.name: Waitress A

text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? I ordered something on
my own!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Unaccustomed to fancy eateries, Oguri
Cap seems a bit on edge at
first. Her
anxiety, however, vanishes along with her
food.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That was delicious. So many flavors I didn't
even know existed. Each
bite was
absolutely divine, but they'd last only a
second...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Hey, I have an idea. Why don't we get
seconds?!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Our meal ended too soon. I feel like I can
eat some more, and since
we're already
here...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list:
Let's do it! But how about we try something
else?

text_block_list.text: Something... else? Now that you mention it, that does sound nice...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
The pasta and pancakes were both
amazing. I'm sure everything else
on the
menu wouldn't disappoint.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
The question is... What do I order next? A
dilemma more difficult
than any school
exam...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп sits at the table, flipping
through the menu for about half
an hour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I can't decide! Everything looks
good! Looking at the menu just
makes me
want to order it all!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Wait... Maybe I'll do exactly that.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Let's order everything on the menu. What
do you say?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Too much, huh? Then could you at least
order for me? What are you
feeling?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп
choice_data_list: The hamburger steak pie sounds delicious.

text_block_list.text: Hmmm... I've never tried that before.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
All right, sounds good. Might as well try it
while we're here, right? I'll
order the food.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Bubbling with childlike excitement, Oguri
Cap raises her hand to call
over the
waitress, ordering a "beef pie thing" for
the two of us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The pie crust is nice and crispy, and the
balance of sweetness and
acidity in the
berry sauce is perfect! Not to mention the
super juicy
patty...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, I feel like I could be
dreaming.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I wasn't too sure about eating meat with a
fruity sauce, but this was
better than I
imagined.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the recommendation. I would
never have tried something
like this if it
weren't for you.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It's nice to get out of my comfort zone
once in a while and eat what
other people
like!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today. The food was
fantastic, and I had a bunch of
fun.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
That's good to hear. This day couldn't be
any better.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: All right. On to our next destination.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I usually only go to nearby places when I'm
alone, but since you said
you'd show me
around, I wanna make the most of it.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I highlighted a couple other shops that
caught my eye while I was
preparing for
this trip.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
It might not be lunchtime anymore, but
judging by the state of my
stomach, I
could stop by at least 10 more spots.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Since we're going to spend the entire day
cafe hopping, I'll be
counting on you,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп quickly picks up her pace, and
we end up popping into
every single cafe
on her list...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
